frame: origin at the front middle of 安佑宫's box F0096 at its ground; z south along S01's axis, x east, y up (scripts/model_site.py)

layout.value: as S01 draws the compound, re-read in plan pixels (plan_readings.csv)
layout.note: Round 27 reading on 2.5-6x crops with a 5 px grid; placed by the fit in use (research/georef/); S01 is B until Q2 is settled

axis.value: one straight axis from the hall to the middle of the four 华表
axis.note: the middles S01 draws on it (hall, terrace, flights, 安佑门, the bridges' middles, the three gates, the qilin, the south archway, the 华表 square, the north gate) spread over a few metres (report.json axis_spread_m); the axis-borne parts are centred on their mean

hall_bays.value: nine bays, ten column lines across the front, as S01 draws them
hall_bays.note: S05 j81:20a 重檐正殿九楹 (A); S01's ten lines (B, plan_readings.csv hall_cols); Malone: ten pillars across the front, forty in all (S02 p.88 n., E1562, B: what he counted on the ruin's platform)

hall_depth.value: four rows of columns, three spans back to front about 4.2, 7.2 and 2.6 m, the front span a porch
hall_depth.note: S01's four rows (hall_rows); with the ten lines Malone's forty pillars; the porch's depth and the doors behind it C

hall_size.value: about 30 x 14 m between the end columns, by S01
hall_size.note: the box of Round 2 (34 x 20.5 m) came from the hall scale of 4.2 px/m, C; by the fit in use S01's columns span 30 m and 14 m; no stated size is known (the Yangshi Lei sheet 安佑宫供器尺寸及殿底样, E1566, not seen)

hall_roof.value: double-eaved 歇山 in yellow glazed tile
hall_roof.note: the leaf: a gable triangle shows at the east end of the upper roof, so 歇山 (S08 P0017, A for 1744); S360's note (E1560): nine bays, 重檐歇山, yellow glazed; Malone: a double roof of yellow glazed tile (E1562)

hall_col.note: the leaf paints the lower columns about 0.15 of the hall's width (P0017, read on the 1300 px copy); with S01's 30 m, 4.6 m; the leaf's fit (research/scenes/YM17-hongci-yonghu/plate_fit.csv) tests it; the 举架 and the upper storey the grand_hall class (C)

hall_front.value: red lattice doors in all nine bays behind a porch of red columns, green-blue beams under both eaves
hall_front.note: the leaf on the enlarged crop (ym17_c1, Round 7): red columns, red lattice, green-blue painted beams under both eaves; the doors' pattern C

hall_plaque.note: S05 j81:21a 與安佑門安佑宫額皆御書; the board C

terrace.value: one marble terrace under the hall and before it, T-shaped as S01 draws it, 1.6 m above the court, balustraded, five flights
terrace.note: S01's outline (platform and 月台 as one, no line between) (B); Malone: a marble terrace with five stairs, the middle one carved with dragons (E1562, B); the leaf: white balustrades (A); its height C: the ramp stone 3.15 m long (S943) laid at a stair's slope gives 1.4 m, S01's flights (3.6-5.1 m long) 1.8-2.6 m at 0.15 m risers

flights.value: three flights at the front, one on each side of the 月台, as S01 draws them, their runs S01's
flights.note: S01 (flight_C, _W, _E, _SW, _SE); Malone's five stairs (E1562); the risers 0.15 m and so the treads from the runs C

ramp.value: the dragon-and-cloud ramp stone 御路 in the middle flight, 1.30 m wide
ramp.note: one of its stones is at Peking University, 3.15 x 1.30 m, the relief 1.00 m wide, its pair at the east gate of 颐和园 (S943); the carving drawn as raised blocks (C)

bronzes.value: two censers, two cranes and two deer on the terrace
bronzes.note: E1564 (S361): bronze deer and cranes before the hall; Malone: incense burners and bronze birds and animals (E1562); the leaf: vessels on the terrace (A, too small to name); places and forms C

beiting.value: two octagonal stele pavilions with double eaves, yellow, over marble steles
beiting.note: S05 碑亭各一 (A); Malone: two double-roofed pavilions over marble steles (E1562, B); the leaf: double eaves, yellow (A); S01's octagons about 6.6 m (B); walls, arched doors and heights C

peidian.value: the side halls, five bays each, single-eave 歇山 in yellow tile
peidian.note: S05 左右配殿各五楹 (A); S01's cells against the inner wall (B); the leaf: yellow 歇山 roofs (A); heights and porches C

liaoting.value: two green-glazed burners 燎炉 by the inner gate
liaoting.note: S05 燎亭各一 (A); Malone: two green glazed incense burners in the inner court (E1562, B); at S01's squares; their form C

gate.value: 安佑门: five bays, single-eave 歇山 in yellow tile, on a marble terrace in the inner wall
gate.note: S05 宫門五楹南向為安佑門 (A); the leaf: a yellow-roofed gate hall with a white terrace and balustrade before it (A); Malone: a marble terrace with the inner gate (E1563, B); S01: 12.3 x 6.3 m between its columns, a middle row on the wall line (B); the widths' split, the column 3.8 m, the terrace 1.2 m and its depth C

walls.value: two red walls with yellow glazed coping
walls.note: Malone (E1563, B); S01's lines (B); the leaf paints both walls vermilion, their caps read grey-green on the leaf (A for the red; the cap's yellow is Malone's); heights 4.2 and 4.4 m and thickness C

inner_side_gates.value: a small gate either side of 安佑门 in the inner wall, yellow roofs
inner_side_gates.note: S01's cells (B); the leaf: small gates with yellow roofs (A); their form C

inner_moat.value: a moon river between the walls, lined with stone, five marble bridges
inner_moat.note: S05 門前白玉石橋三座 (A); Malone: a second moat with three bridges and two side bridges (E1563, B); S01's channel and breaks (B, water RM002); its lining, railing and the bridges' form C

chaofang.value: waiting rooms 朝房, five bays each, between the walls
chaofang.note: S05 朝房各五楹 (A); S01's cells (B); their form the class's (C)

jingting.value: two well pavilions between the walls
jingting.note: S05 左右井亭各一 (A); Malone: two covered wells (E1563, B); S01's squares (B); the form C

outer_gates.value: five gates in the outer wall: three glazed gates in the middle, a smaller gate at each side
outer_gates.note: Malone: five gates in a red wall (E1563, B); S01's blocks (B); the leaf: three arched gates with glazed frames and yellow roofs, red doors, and small side gates with yellow roofs (A); sizes and heights C

qilin.value: two stone qilin on stone bases before the three middle gates
qilin.note: Malone (E1563, B); S943: 1.74 m high on bases 0.98 m high, 1.41 x 1.95 m, each beast and its base cut from two stones; first before 大宫门, here from 1741; at Peking University since 1925 (B); S01's squares (B); the beast's form C (no photograph on disk)

sanfang.value: three timber archways 三坊 before the gates, red posts held by diagonal props, small yellow roofs
sanfang.note: S05 坊南及東西復有三坊環列 with their six faces named (A); the leaf: timber archways with red diagonal props 戗杆 and yellow roofs with green-blue painted beams (A); S01's bars, 9.3-9.6 m (B); four posts and three roofs, heights C

outer_moat.value: the outer moat 月河, a U round the forecourt, lined with stone, red railings on its banks, five marble bridges
outer_moat.note: S05 其南為月河橋 (A); Malone: five marble bridges, the middle one for the emperor alone (E1563, B); the leaf: three white arched bridges with balustrades and red railings along the banks (A); S01's band and breaks (B, water RM003); the two end bridges' form C

zhifu.value: 致孚殿: three bays facing west in a red-walled yard, yellow tile
zhifu.note: S05 又東南為致孚殿三楹西向 (A), with the carved 圆明园记 inside (S05 j81:21b); the leaf: a small yellow-roofed hall in a red-walled yard (A); S01's yard and cells (B); heights C

liulifang.value: the glazed archway 鸿慈永祜坊: three glazed gates between four short red walls with glazed discs
liulifang.note: S05: 琉璃坊座南面額 鸿慈永祜, north face 燕翼長詒 (A); Malone: a glazed pailou of four short walls and three gates (E1561, B); the leaf: three gates with blue-green glazed frames and yellow roofs between red walls with round glazed panels (A); S01's bar 13.7 x 2.5 m (B); heights C

huabiao.value: four marble 华表 at the corners of a square of 30 m round the archway, 8 m high on octagonal bases 1.24 m high
huabiao.note: Malone: four marble pillars about 100 ft apart at the corners of a square (E1561); S01's squares 30.2 x 30.0 m apart (B); S980, S818: about 8 m high, the base 1.24 m (B); S05 has 左右石華表各一 (two, Q179): four drawn; the dragon, the cloud board, the dew plate and the beast after P0196 (c. 1882) and P0809-P0813 (today), their sizes C

colours.value: red walls and columns, yellow glazed roofs, green-blue beams, white marble
colours.note: the leaf (S08 P0017, A for 1744); Malone's yellow glazed tile (E1562, E1563)

corner_ranges.value: a long range in a walled yard in each north corner of the outer court
corner_ranges.note: S01's cells and yard lines (B); S05 names no building there: unnamed (C: a store or kitchen range, grey tile)

north_gate.value: a gate of three bays in the outer wall's north side

paving.value: the forecourt, the ways on the axis and between the gates paved; the courts earth with their trees
paving.note: the leaf paints the forecourt and the inner court grey; the planting of Round 12 keeps its trees in the courts (research/greens/species.csv GS-0634)
